title: RetrievalResult
description: Outcome of one retrieve job attempt (OQ-05 section 7.1). It distinguishes a complete or partial snapshot, no observations and failure. Every provider request is recorded, billed or not. A retrieval result is never an official numerical result. An accepted snapshot makes the job COMPLETED with its coverage recorded. A failure makes the job FAILED after the bounded retry policy.

RetrievalSnapshot.title: RetrievalSnapshot
RetrievalSnapshot.description: A frozen dataset-manifest/1 was uploaded. Its coverage repeats status. PARTIAL and NO_OBSERVATIONS are visible outcomes, not failures: the job is COMPLETED, and missing data that a run requires blocks the work that depends on it.

RetrievalFailure.title: RetrievalFailure
RetrievalFailure.description: No snapshot. Only transient classes are retried, within max_retries and the attempt cap; then the job is FAILED. AUTHENTICATION, PERMISSION, UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, CANCELLED and EGRESS_REFUSED are never retried (OQ-05 sections 4 and 7.1), so retryable is false for them; the schema rejects true. EGRESS_REFUSED is a configuration or policy failure, not a transient one. retry_after_seconds preserves a provider Retry-After value when present.

RetrievalErrorClass.title: RetrievalErrorClass
RetrievalErrorClass.description: Provider error classes (OQ-05 section 7.1). EGRESS_REFUSED: the egress allowlist refused a host, method, path or redirect.

ProviderCall.title: ProviderCall
ProviderCall.description: One provider request. http_status is absent when no response arrived. error is present when the call failed.

RetrievalUsage.title: RetrievalUsage
RetrievalUsage.description: Provider requests and credits consumed, and the job duration. Unknown billed usage stays reserved.
